dialogues.jp: 公園のおくまった場所には、小さな高台がある。
dialogues.en: There's a hill at the back of the park.
dialogues.text: There's a hill at the back of the park.

dialogues.jp:
長い階段を上らなくてはいけなく、普段は面倒
なので上らないのだけれども。
dialogues.en:
There is a long flight of stairs to get there. I usually
don't go up there because it's too much for me.
dialogues.text:
There is a long flight of stairs to get there. I usually
don't go up there because it's too much for me.

dialogues.en: "I see the ocean..."
dialogues.text: "I see the ocean..."

dialogues.jp: 息切れしながら柵に寄りかかって目を細める。
dialogues.en: I squint, leaning against the fence out of breath.
dialogues.text: I squint, leaning against the fence out of breath.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「きれいでしょ」
dialogues.en: "Isn't it beautiful?"
dialogues.text: "Isn't it beautiful?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あ、まぁな」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, kind of."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, kind of."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「きれい、でしょパパ！」
dialogues.en: "It's beautiful, isn't it, papa?"
dialogues.text: "It's beautiful, isn't it, papa?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「まだ続いてたのか……それ」
dialogues.en: "Are you still asking me the same question?"
dialogues.text: "Are you still asking me the same question?"

dialogues.jp:
聞き慣れるのも言われ慣れるのも嫌だが、気分
は悪くない。
dialogues.en:
I don't want to get used to hearing or being called 'papa',
but I think it's not that bad.
dialogues.text:
I don't want to get used to hearing or being called 'papa',
but I think it's not that bad.

dialogues.jp: 多分、可笑しい。
dialogues.en: It is somewhat cute.
dialogues.text: It is somewhat cute.

dialogues.jp: 「あぁ、きれいだ」
dialogues.en: "Yes, it's beautiful."
dialogues.text: "Yes, it's beautiful."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「海、今もまだ泳げる？」
dialogues.en: "Do you think you can still swim in the ocean?"
dialogues.text: "Do you think you can still swim in the ocean?"

dialogues.jp: さくらが海に向かって手を広げる。
dialogues.en: Sakura spreads her arms wide at the ocean.
dialogues.text: Sakura spreads her arms wide at the ocean.

dialogues.jp: 俺は逆に、柵に背を預けて空を眺めた。
dialogues.en:
On the other hand, I lean against the fence and look up at
the sky.
dialogues.text:
On the other hand, I lean against the fence and look up at
the sky.

dialogues.jp:
「そうだな、場所は減ったけど泳げなくもない。
　スキューバも出来るよ」
dialogues.en:
"Well, there are fewer spots for swimming these days, but I
can still swim, and I also do scuba diving."
dialogues.text:
"Well, there are fewer spots for swimming these days, but I
can still swim, and I also do scuba diving."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「夏にならないかなぁ」
dialogues.en: "When will it be summer?"
dialogues.text: "When will it be summer?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「夏休みが待ち遠しいよなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "Yeah, I can't wait for summer."
dialogues.text: "Yeah, I can't wait for summer."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　あははははは♪」
dialogues.en: "Hm? Ahahahaha!"
dialogues.text: "Hm? Ahahahaha!"

dialogues.jp:
こんな晴れた日曜には珍しく、辺りには人気が
なく、桜に囲まれながらふたりして大笑いした。
dialogues.en:
Both of us burst out laughing as the cherry blossoms
surround us. For a change, there aren't many people around
on the marvelous Sunday afternoon.
dialogues.text:
Both of us burst out laughing as the cherry blossoms
surround us. For a change, there aren't many people around
on the marvelous Sunday afternoon.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「絶対行こうね海！　約束だよ！」
dialogues.en: "Let's go to the ocean together! Promise?"
dialogues.text: "Let's go to the ocean together! Promise?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あぁ」
dialogues.en: "Yeah."
dialogues.text: "Yeah."

dialogues.jp:
春の柔らかな日差しの中で、夏の匂いを思い出
す。
dialogues.en:
I remember the scent of summer as I bathe in the soft spring
sun now.
dialogues.text:
I remember the scent of summer as I bathe in the soft spring
sun now.

dialogues.jp:
初音島の夏は、海からの潮風と、香水のように
強く香る桜の匂いなのだ。
dialogues.en:
The summer on Hatsune Island has a scent of an ocean breeze
and of the strong perfume of cherry blossoms.
dialogues.text:
The summer on Hatsune Island has a scent of an ocean breeze
and of the strong perfume of cherry blossoms.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ〜、水着買わなきゃね」
dialogues.en: "Hm... I'll have to buy a bathing suit."
dialogues.text: "Hm... I'll have to buy a bathing suit."

dialogues.jp:
どう想像しても、さくらがスクール水着以外の
ものを着ている姿が想像できなかったが……俺
のせいではないだろう。
dialogues.en:
I can't imagine Sakura wearing a bathing suit, not the one
from school... but, anyway, it's not my fault.
dialogues.text:
I can't imagine Sakura wearing a bathing suit, not the one
from school... but, anyway, it's not my fault.

dialogues.jp:
「さて、まずは腹ごしらえしよう。冷めちゃっ
　てるだろうけどな」
dialogues.en: "Let's eat now. They're probably cold by now."
dialogues.text: "Let's eat now. They're probably cold by now."

dialogues.jp: 熱のない紙袋をかかげる。
dialogues.en: I hold up a cold paper bag.
dialogues.text: I hold up a cold paper bag.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……ちょっと袋貸して」
dialogues.en: "Give me the bag."
dialogues.text: "Give me the bag."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.jp: ひょい、と小さな手が袋を抱え込む。
dialogues.en: Her little hand grabs the bag quickly.
dialogues.text: Her little hand grabs the bag quickly.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ……んぎゅ〜」
dialogues.en: "Hmmm... Mmm..."
dialogues.text: "Hmmm... Mmm..."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「おぃ、潰すなよ」
dialogues.en: "Hey, don't squeeze them."
dialogues.text: "Hey, don't squeeze them."

dialogues.jp:
慌てて止めようとするが、すぐに袋を離してさ
くらは小首をかしげた。
dialogues.en:
I try to stop her, but she quickly takes them out of the bag
with a tilt of her head.
dialogues.text:
I try to stop her, but she quickly takes them out of the bag
with a tilt of her head.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫だよ。ほら、あったかほかほか♪」
dialogues.en: "It's still warm, look!"
dialogues.text: "It's still warm, look!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.en: "Meooow!"
dialogues.text: "Meooow!"

dialogues.jp:
開いた紙袋の中から、湯気と焼けたパンの匂い
が溢れ出す。
dialogues.en:
The opened paper bag lets out steam and the smell of a
burger.
dialogues.text:
The opened paper bag lets out steam and the smell of a
burger.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「愛情電子レンジだよパパ♪」
dialogues.en: "I'm a walking microwave oven of love, papa!"
dialogues.text: "I'm a walking microwave oven of love, papa!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「冗談」
dialogues.en: "You're kidding me."
dialogues.text: "You're kidding me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「まだ温かかっただけだよ。袋が冷たいっての
　は保温性がいいからでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, actually they've been warm in the bag. The reason you
felt cold on the bag was because it held warmth inside, I
think."
dialogues.text:
"Well, actually they've been warm in the bag. The reason you
felt cold on the bag was because it held warmth inside, I
think."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そんなもんだっけ？」
dialogues.en: "Is that right?"
dialogues.text: "Is that right?"

dialogues.jp: ベンチに座り、包みを開けながら呟く。
dialogues.en: I mutter, sitting on the bench opening the wrapping paper.
dialogues.text: I mutter, sitting on the bench opening the wrapping paper.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うたまるにもあげるけど、油っこいからちょっ
　とだけ。お腹こわしちゃうからね」
dialogues.en:
"I'll give you some, but only a little bit, because this is
very greasy for you. I don't want you to get a tummy ache,
Utamaru."
dialogues.text:
"I'll give you some, but only a little bit, because this is
very greasy for you. I don't want you to get a tummy ache,
Utamaru."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ」
dialogues.en: "Meow."
dialogues.text: "Meow."

dialogues.jp: さくらは離れた草の上で猫に説教をしている。
dialogues.en:
Sakura gives the cat a lecture on the grass, a little away
from me.
dialogues.text:
Sakura gives the cat a lecture on the grass, a little away
from me.

dialogues.en: "Huhh..."
dialogues.text: "Huhh..."

dialogues.jp: なぜだろう。
dialogues.en: I wonder why?
dialogues.text: I wonder why?

dialogues.jp: 俺はさくらのことが好きだ。
dialogues.en: I love Sakura.
dialogues.text: I love Sakura.

dialogues.jp: 「さくら」
dialogues.en: "Sakura."
dialogues.text: "Sakura."

dialogues.jp:
ベンチに座って、背中を丸めてさくらを見つめ
る。
dialogues.en: I watch Sakura as I sit on the bench with my back hunched.
dialogues.text: I watch Sakura as I sit on the bench with my back hunched.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「んにゃ、なーにパパ？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm, what is it, papa?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm, what is it, papa?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「好きだ」
dialogues.en: "I love you."
dialogues.text: "I love you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ボクもだよ！」
dialogues.en: "You too!"
dialogues.text: "You too!"

dialogues.jp:
真面目だけれども、からかったつもりなのに。
恥ずかしくて目を海に向けた。
dialogues.en:
I was joking even though I meant it. I look at the ocean,
feeling embarrassed.
dialogues.text:
I was joking even though I meant it. I look at the ocean,
feeling embarrassed.

dialogues.jp:
素で即答されると、恥ずかしくてたまらんな
……。
dialogues.en: I can't deal with it when she responds to it so quickly.
dialogues.text: I can't deal with it when she responds to it so quickly.

dialogues.jp:
あ、音夢がたまに、俺に対してこれと同じこと
をしていたっけ。
dialogues.en: Oh, I remember Nemu used to do the same thing to me.
dialogues.text: Oh, I remember Nemu used to do the same thing to me.

dialogues.en: "Shoot..."
dialogues.text: "Shoot..."

dialogues.jp:
自分がずっとバカみたいだと思っていたことが、
こんなに楽しいなんて。
dialogues.en:
I always used to think this was ridiculous... I never knew
it would be so much fun.
dialogues.text:
I always used to think this was ridiculous... I never knew
it would be so much fun.

dialogues.jp: それこそ恥ずかしかった。
dialogues.en: Now I feel more embarrassed.
dialogues.text: Now I feel more embarrassed.

dialogues.jp:
さくらとご飯を食べて、話をして、街を見下ろ
して島の説明をしながら時間をつぶす。
dialogues.en:
I pass the time with Sakura by eating lunch, talking and
explaining about this island as we look down at the town.
dialogues.text:
I pass the time with Sakura by eating lunch, talking and
explaining about this island as we look down at the town.

dialogues.jp: いや、その時間を楽しんだ。
dialogues.en: Yes, I had a really great time.
dialogues.text: Yes, I had a really great time.

dialogues.jp:
なるべく学園の話はしたくなくて、お互いに、
無駄なことばかり話していた。
dialogues.en:
We didn't want to talk about school, so instead we talked
about frivolous stuff.
dialogues.text:
We didn't want to talk about school, so instead we talked
about frivolous stuff.

dialogues.jp:
最近読んだマンガとか、目に付いた桜の木を数
えてみたり、白い雲がなにに見えるかとか――。
dialogues.en:
We talked about the comic books I've read recently, counted
the cherry trees we could see, and described what images we
saw in the clouds...
dialogues.text:
We talked about the comic books I've read recently, counted
the cherry trees we could see, and described what images we
saw in the clouds...

dialogues.jp: いつのまにか猫は消えていた。
dialogues.en: The cat has gone somewhere.
dialogues.text: The cat has gone somewhere.

dialogues.jp:
パパ、と俺をからかい逃げるさくらを追いかけ
て、背中からつかまえる。
dialogues.en:
Sakura keeps calling me 'papa', so I chase her around, and
finally grab her on the back.
dialogues.text:
Sakura keeps calling me 'papa', so I chase her around, and
finally grab her on the back.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、つかまっちった」
dialogues.en: "Hm, you got me."
dialogues.text: "Hm, you got me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "You got me."
dialogues.text: "You got me."

dialogues.jp:
首を曲げて、空を見るように｛まぶ／眩｝しそうに俺を見
つめる小さな目。
dialogues.en: I put my lips over hers as the sky connects to the horizon.
dialogues.text: I put my lips over hers as the sky connects to the horizon.

dialogues.jp: 青い瞳に自分が映っている。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「つかまっちった」
dialogues.en: "You can't... because you're my papa now."
dialogues.text: "You can't... because you're my papa now."

dialogues.jp:
そっと、さくらの額に唇を乗せる。唇同士じゃ
恥ずかしいから、親愛の印に。
dialogues.en:
Acting like a girl of her age, Sakura covers her breasts in
embarrassment.
dialogues.text:
Acting like a girl of her age, Sakura covers her breasts in
embarrassment.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「へへへ……なんかホントのパパみたい」
dialogues.en: "Nyahahaha... the forehead or cheeks, papa."
dialogues.text: "Nyahahaha... the forehead or cheeks, papa."

dialogues.jp:
草むらの上でさくらを抱きかかえていると、さ
くらがクスクスと笑う。
dialogues.en:
I lie down on the grass snuggling around her body, and
Sakura starts to chuckle.
dialogues.text:
I lie down on the grass snuggling around her body, and
Sakura starts to chuckle.

dialogues.jp: 鈴を転がすように。
dialogues.en: It sounds like a bell.
dialogues.text: It sounds like a bell.

dialogues.jp: 桜が風に舞う。
dialogues.en: The cherry petals flutter in the wind.
dialogues.text: The cherry petals flutter in the wind.

dialogues.jp: そんな。
dialogues.en: That is...
dialogues.text: That is...

dialogues.jp: 幸せな。
dialogues.en: Happiness.
dialogues.text: Happiness.

dialogues.jp: 春の午後。
dialogues.en: In one spring afternoon.
dialogues.text: In one spring afternoon.

dialogues.jp: ◆海を望む午後◆
dialogues.en: ◆An afternoon promise to go to the ocean◆
dialogues.text: ◆An afternoon promise to go to the ocean◆

dialogues.jp:
昼下がりの公園の高台。遠い海を見ながら、さ
くらとのほほんとした昼を過ごす。
dialogues.en:
One afternoon on the hill in the park. I spent a relaxing
afternoon with Sakura watching the big ocean.
dialogues.text:
One afternoon on the hill in the park. I spent a relaxing
afternoon with Sakura watching the big ocean.

dialogues.jp:
今度は、夏になったら一緒に海に泳ぎに行こう
と約束を交わした。
dialogues.en:
We made a promise to go swimming in the ocean when the
summer comes.
dialogues.text:
We made a promise to go swimming in the ocean when the
summer comes.
